name: gym-webapp

dependencies.name: gym-api
dependencies.description: Calls the API to manage targets, logs, coach links and feedback.

description: React single-page app where a Trainee signs in, sets targets, logs meals and workouts, reviews daily/weekly progress, and manages a Coach invite; a Coach signs in to accept invites, review a linked Trainee's progress read-only, and leave feedback. Holds no persistent data itself — all state lives behind gym-api.
